reason: This plugin is primarily an AI-augmented workflow orchestrator for drug-discovery research sessions in DeepSeek Harness, as shown by its `research_*` and `artifact_*` toolset, bundled DSH integration, and skill-based session structure, with file/provenance management as the core operational scope.

summaries.zh: dsh-aidd 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，提供研究循环与可追溯成果管理工具，帮助药物发现项目按阶段组织实验、假设与版本化产物。
summaries.en: dsh-aidd is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides research-loop and provenance-aware artifact tools to structure drug-discovery projects by experiment stages and tracked outputs.

capabilities: Project-level research workflow orchestration via persisted research loop tools
Versioned artifact tracking with provenance metadata for outputs and checkpoints
Installation and discovery of predefined DSH skills for domain workflows
Local file/project scaffolding and validation test scripts included in package
